'''Colliders Casino''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]].<ref name="DarthPlagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> It was run by a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Unidentified Sullustan manager|manager]] and was host to a series of large winning streaks around [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]]. As part of his mission to eliminate potential rivals, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] tracked down the being responsible, a [[Unidentified Shi'ido|certain]] [[Shi'ido]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]], who was of interest to [[Darth Venamis]], employed by [[Kerred Santhe the Second|Kerred Santhe the Younger]] to win big under different personas, including as a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]], a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]], and a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]].<ref name="DarthPlagueis"></ref>
